title: Mirabel and the Veil Revisited
author: Ivo Brightwater
blurb: Elodie Underhill, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
